hero.description: I'm a Product Designer and Certified Scrum Master. That combination is rare, and it's what lets me bridge Design and Engineering without losing either side. I turn complex requirements into structured, shippable product. Teams move faster. The right thing gets built.

stats.d: Enterprise tools across agile team setups

coreCapabilities.title: The way I work.
coreCapabilities.subtitle: I work best where the problem is unclear, the stakes are real, and the team needs someone who can hold both the design and the delivery.

items.title: Strategic Thinking & Concepting
items.body: I start by finding where the real problem actually is. That means asking uncomfortable questions, assessing risks early, and resisting the urge to jump to solutions. Once the picture is clear, I guide clients in the right direction with empathy, structured processes, and Scrum as the delivery backbone. And when we're heading for a wall, I say so.

items.title: UX & Research
items.body: Talk to users, find the gaps, turn findings into requirements. I run testing at every stage so the design keeps getting sharper as the project moves forward.

items.title: Agile Delivery & Scrum
items.body: Certified Scrum Master with real sprint experience. I facilitate ceremonies, write developer-ready specs, and keep design and engineering moving in the same direction.

items.title: Process & Complexity
items.body: Some problems are messy by nature. I map how things actually work, find where the bloat is, and restructure it into something people can use without a manual.

leadership.title: Leadership
leadership.bodyHtml: Co-founded a regional cultural festival and led visual identity, digital experience, and team operations. Grew it from zero to 3,000+ attendees over three years.

selectedWorks.title: Work
selectedWorks.subtitle: Case studies showcasing how I collaborate with teams to build accessible and scalable digital products.

footer.title: Let’s connect
footer.subtitle: Complex system, tight deadline, difficult stakeholders? That’s when I’m most useful.

education.heading: Education

timeline.degree: Master of Science, User Experience Design
Bachelor of Science, User Experience Design

academicTheses.label: Master Thesis
academicTheses.title: The Influence of Environment Design on Attention & Learning: A Comparison of Abstract and Biophilic VR Environments
academicTheses.body: Evaluated the impact of nature-inspired (biophilic) vs. abstract Virtual Reality environments on cognitive load and learning performance. Supervised by Prof. Dr. Andreas Riener and Veronika Ritzer, the research demonstrated that biophilic design significantly improves focus and stress reduction in immersive systems.

academicTheses.label: Bachelor Thesis
academicTheses.title: Talking Cars: Evaluation of an Auditory Concept for Communication between Pedestrians and Autonomous Vehicles
academicTheses.body: Developed and evaluated an auditory external Human-Machine Interface (eHMI) to bridge the communication gap between autonomous vehicles and pedestrians. Used a user-centered design process and empirical study to analyze the intuitiveness of natural speech versus abstract sounds.

moduleProjects.detail: Conducted an industry-level study project for BSH, achieving high academic recognition and subsequent feature at the ICC.

Achieved top academic marks in forward-looking UX disciplines, including Natural User Interfaces (Grade: 1.0), Mobile App Prototyping (Grade: 1.3), and Augmented & Virtual Reality Applications (Grade: 1.3).
Taught by Veronika Ritzer, focusing on the strategic alignment of design processes with corporate enterprise goals (Grade: 1.3).
Deepened technical and conceptual knowledge in Interaction Design (Grade: 1.7) and Programming for Multimodal, Interactive Systems (Grade: 1.7) under Prof. Dr. Andreas Riener.
